notes.title: Bug Fix – NVIDIA Users Can Now Actually See What They’re Clicking On
notes.notes:
When you think it’s death ... it’s not. 
 

So, the minimaps were fully clickable all along — but if you had a NVIDIA GPU, you maybe just couldn’t see what you were clicking.

Yep, you were wandering around blind, clicking on invisible islands like some kind of stealth explorer...

And nobody told me.
Which means either:

[olist]
[*] You’re all psychic strategists who knew exactly where to go,

[*] Or you thought the minimaps were just fancy, invisible art,

[*] Or you just love surprises when teleporting to mystery islands.
[/olist]

Good news:
Now NVIDIA users can finally see the islands before invading them.

Also, while digging into this, i squashed a couple of bugs in the motion blur — so things should look smoother too.

😉

If this fix introduces any new bugs or if you still find other weirdness, please don’t hesitate to let us know! We love a good mystery.

notes.title: Shields Bugfixes and Sale
notes.notes:
With today's update, there is a new feature. 

[b]Shields. [/b]

They protect your base for a short time. The cost of this is very low, sacrifice 3 mages to summon the shield. Peanuts or not ?


[b]Fixes[/b]

In addition, a few errors in the translations have been erased.

And the scanner function of the mages has been reworked a bit, the search for enemies now costs a little less performance.


[b]Sale[/b]

In addition, there is a 50% discount for the next few days.

notes.title: Maniac Land Is Now Online
notes.notes:
The time has come! 

The gates to Maniac Land are open, and the land awaits its rightful... or, well, maybe not-so-rightful, but definitely craziest ruler!


To celebrate the launch, we’re offering a 12% discount – because, you know, 10% is just too basic! 

And in case a little bug snuck in somewhere, don’t worry: the swatter is ready for action! 
If you spot one, please post it in the Bugs Forum so we can squash it fast.

By the way, the first free expansion is already in the works – but for now, it’s Bugs and Wishes first!


Good luck in Maniac Land, and may the craziest wizard win!
